_llm_instructions: Fill in the 'project_title' and 'date_prepared' properties, and the 'value' property of each field, based on the provided project context. Reference parameters.md for global project variables.

f01_Description.label: Description
f01_Description.guidance: Provide a summary-level description of the project or phase: what it was, its purpose, and its boundaries. Keep it to a summary, and point to the project charter for detail.

f02_Scope_Objectives.label: Scope Objectives
f02_Scope_Objectives.guidance: Describe the scope objectives needed to achieve the planned benefits of the project.

f03_Completion_Criteria.label: Completion Criteria
f03_Completion_Criteria.guidance: Document the specific and measurable criteria needed to complete the scope objectives. State each one so that it can be answered met or not met.

f04_How_Met.label: How Met
f04_How_Met.guidance: Provide the evidence that the completion criteria were met. Give the source of the evidence, such as the document, test result, or acceptance record, not only the conclusion.

f05_Quality_Objectives.label: Quality Objectives
f05_Quality_Objectives.guidance: Describe the quality objectives and criteria needed to achieve the planned benefits of the project.

f06_Quality_Criteria.label: Quality Criteria
f06_Quality_Criteria.guidance: Document the specific and measurable criteria needed to meet the product and project quality objectives.

f07_Verification_and_Validation.label: Verification and Validation
f07_Verification_and_Validation.guidance: Enter the verification and validation information from the product acceptance form. Cross-reference that form rather than restating it, so the two records cannot drift apart.

f08_Time_Objectives.label: Time Objectives
f08_Time_Objectives.guidance: The planned time objectives, being the approved schedule baseline duration and the planned completion date.

f09_Final_Completion_Date.label: Final Completion Date
f09_Final_Completion_Date.guidance: The actual date the project or phase was completed.

f10_Time_Variance.label: Time Variance
f10_Time_Variance.guidance: The difference between the planned and actual completion, and the reason for it. Where the project finished early, say so and explain why, since an unexplained favourable variance hides a planning error just as a delay does.

f11_Cost_Objectives.label: Cost Objectives
f11_Cost_Objectives.guidance: The approved cost baseline, or the total budget at completion if no baseline applies.

f12_Final_Expenditures.label: Final Expenditures
f12_Final_Expenditures.guidance: The actual total spent at completion, and whether it includes contingency drawn or reserve released.

f13_Cost_Variance.label: Cost Variance
f13_Cost_Variance.guidance: The difference between the planned and actual cost, in currency and as a percentage, and the reason for it.

f14_How_Benefits_Were_Achieved.label: How Benefits Were Achieved
f14_How_Benefits_Were_Achieved.guidance: Describe how the final product, service, or result achieved the benefits the project was undertaken to address. Identify the benefit and the evidence that it was realised, distinguishing a benefit that was realised from one that is still expected.

f15_Benefits_Realisation_Status.label: Benefits Realisation Status
f15_Benefits_Realisation_Status.guidance: The current realisation status of each benefit, and who owns tracking it after the project team has been released.

f16_How_Business_Needs_Were_Met.label: How Business Needs Were Met
f16_How_Business_Needs_Were_Met.guidance: Describe how the final product, service, or result achieved the business needs identified in the business plan.

f17_Needs_Not_Met.label: Needs Not Met
f17_Needs_Not_Met.guidance: Any business need that was not met, and what happens next now that the project is closed. A need left unstated here will be assumed met by whoever inherits the product.

f18_Significant_Risks_and_Issues.label: Significant Risks and Issues
f18_Significant_Risks_and_Issues.guidance: Summarize any significant risks or issues, or the overall risk exposure, and describe the response and resolution strategies used. Record what remained open at closure, because an unresolved item transferred silently is the one most often lost.

f19_Items_Transferred.label: Items Transferred
f19_Items_Transferred.guidance: Any item transferred to the organization or to operations, with the recipient named. An item with no named recipient has not been transferred.

f20_Contracts_Closed.label: Contracts Closed
f20_Contracts_Closed.guidance: The contracts closed out, with the final contract value and the date of each closure.

f21_Obligations_Discharged.label: Obligations Discharged
f21_Obligations_Discharged.guidance: The obligations, warranties, and service levels that have been met, transferred, or remain outstanding. Name who holds each one now.

f22_Claims_and_Disputes_Settled.label: Claims and Disputes Settled
f22_Claims_and_Disputes_Settled.guidance: Any claim or dispute that was settled before closure, and any that was not. An unresolved claim is a liability the project has just handed on.
